title: App-driver contract, format 1 (quality spec #qc-contract, docs/adr/0025): qc.toml at a target's root
description: Keys follow annotateanything's qa.toml where they fit. Commands run under sh with QC_REPO set to the repo root; no key names a path on this box (#evidence-portable).

format.description: This contract's format version: picks schemas/qc.v<format>.schema.json

setup.description: Installs or builds the app once, run from the repo root

command.description: The app command a user runs; a drive appends its arguments and runs it from the drive's own working directory

services.description: Services the app needs, by name; empty for an app with none

command.description: Starts the service, run from the repo root

ready.description: How the service is known to be ready: the path its URL answers on

fixture.description: Fixtures, by name; empty for an app that keeps no data

reset.description: Resets the fixture, run from the repo root before a drive

path.description: Where the fixture's data lives, relative to the repo root

values.description: Named values criteria refer to and drives use
